name: Tower Drop Party
promptTemplate: Party tower stack game in {{palette}} styling, sliding at {{block_speed}}x speed with {{snap_window}} alignment tolerance, auto-play attract mode {{attract_mode}}, and impact camera shake {{camera_shake}}.

snap_window.hint: Margin to reward a perfect alignment

drop.hint: Hit on your turn to slice and stack the block

listing.blurb: A neon tower block slides across the screen while players take turns timing their drops, slicing overhangs until a miss topples the stack.
listing.prompt: Take turns to build a tower: a block slides back and forth above it, and the person whose turn it is, shown by a big marker in their colour, presses 'drop' to drop it; any overhang is sliced off and falls away, the blocks shrink, and the tower grows until a block misses and it all topples. Make it a party game a whole room can follow from across the floor: bold shapes and bright colours on a dark ground, every player drawn in their own hue, big short labels (a score, GO!, the winner) in a heavy font, and a large, satisfying reaction on screen the instant anyone presses. It must work with one player or forty, scaling its lanes, seats or pieces to room.people and coping with people joining and leaving mid-round; play itself in a lively attract mode whenever nobody has pressed anything for a few seconds; and after a winner is shown, start the next round on its own. Keep it lean: game state in bounded arrays in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080.
